title: Counting 6 to 10 — More Blessings to Count
memory_verse: "Let all the trees of the forest sing for joy." — Psalm 96:12
objective: Students will learn to count from 6 to 10.
content: We already know 1 to 5. Now let's count even higher! 6, 7, 8, 9, 10! Great job!
Count 6 crayons. Count 7 birds in the sky. Count 8 legs on a spider. Count 9 flowers in the garden. Count 10 fingers on both hands!
God made so many things to count. We can count trees, stars, animals, and people. God knows the number of every single thing He made!
activity: Count 10 small objects like buttons or blocks. Practice writing the numbers 6 through 10.
discussion: Can you count all the way to 10?
How many fingers do you have on both hands?
How many legs does a spider have?
